title: Anthropic’s quarterly revenue passed $11.5bn, up more than 14-fold
excerpt: Anthropic told investors its second-quarter revenue passed $11.5bn, more than 14 times a year earlier, with positive adjusted operating income.
content_html:
Anthropic has told prospective investors that second-quarter revenue exceeded $11.5bn, more than 14 times the $787mn it made a year earlier, and that it recorded positive adjusted operating income. The figures are preliminary and come as the company prepares a listing.

Anthropic has told prospective investors that its second-quarter revenue passed $11.5bn. That is more than 14 times the $787mn it recorded in the same quarter of 2025, according to documents seen by Bloomberg.

The sequential jump is almost as steep. First-quarter revenue was $4.73bn, so the company has more than doubled inside three months and made roughly $16.2bn in the first half of the year.

The quieter line matters more. Anthropic recorded positive adjusted operating income in the quarter, which is not something the leading AI labs have been able to say.

All of it is preliminary and could be revised, and Anthropic declined to comment.

What is genuinely new here is the shape of the disclosure. The industry has asked to be valued on annualised run rates, a figure that takes current revenue and multiplies it out, and Anthropic has now put an actual completed quarter and an operating income line in front of investors instead.

The numbers also hold together. Four quarters at $11.5bn works out at $46bn, close to the $47bn run rate the company disclosed in May, which is more consistency than these figures usually show.

Comparison with OpenAI needs care. Its reported figure of more than $40bn is a run rate rather than a quarter’s revenue, and as Bloomberg notes, the two may not be calculated the same way.

The purpose of the disclosure is a listing. Anthropic has filed confidentially and is working with Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan, with backers telling the Financial Times they expect a $2trn valuation in October.

Timing is part of the strategy. An autumn debut would put Anthropic on the public market before OpenAI, whose own valuation is under scrutiny from its investors, and before DeepSeek, which is preparing to file.

There is capacity waiting. Listings have raised $256.4bn this year excluding blank-cheque vehicles, the most since 2021.

Published August 15, 2026 - 5:34 pm UTC

content_html_zh:
Anthropic 告诉潜在投资者，第二季度收入超过 115 亿美元，是上年同期 7.87 亿美元的 14 倍多，并且调整后营业收入为正值。 这些数据是初步数据，是在该公司准备上市时公布的。

Anthropic 告诉潜在投资者，其第二季度营收超过 115 亿美元。 根据彭博社看到的文件，这是 2025 年同一季度 7.87 亿美元的 14 倍多。

连续跳跃几乎同样陡峭。 第一季度的收入为 47.3 亿美元，因此该公司在三个月内增长了一倍多，今年上半年的收入约为 162 亿美元。

更安静的线路更重要。 Anthropic 在本季度录得正调整营业收入，这是领先的人工智能实验室无法透露的。

所有这些都是初步的，可能会进行修改，Anthropic 拒绝发表评论。

这里真正新颖的是披露的形式。 该行业要求根据年化运行率进行估值，该数字将当前收入相乘，而 Anthropic 现在将实际完成的季度和营业收入线摆在投资者面前。

这些数字也保持一致。 四个季度的 115 亿美元运行结果为 460 亿美元，接近该公司 5 月份披露的 470 亿美元运行率，这比这些数字通常显示的更加一致。

与 OpenAI 的比较需要谨慎。 其报道的超过 400 亿美元的数字是一个运行率，而不是一个季度的收入，正如彭博社指出的那样，两者的计算方式可能不同。

披露的目的是上市。 Anthropic 已秘密提交文件，并正在与摩根士丹利、高盛和摩根大通合作，其支持者告诉英国《金融时报》，他们预计 10 月份的估值将达到 2 万美元。

时机是策略的一部分。 Anthropic 将于秋季上市，其估值将先于 OpenAI 和 DeepSeek 之前上市，后者的估值正受到投资者的审查，而 DeepSeek 正准备提交申请。

有容量等待。 不包括空白支票车辆，今年上市融资额达 2564 亿美元，为 2021 年以来的最高水平。
